name: calcom_list_event_types
description: List a user's bookable event types (the scheduling templates, e.g. '30 Min Meeting'). Provide `username`. Each returned event type has an `id` (the `eventTypeId`) and `lengthInMinutes` you need to check slots and create a booking.

username.description: The cal.com username whose event types to list (from calcom_get_me).
